commit.message: Backend: update google-auth-library@11
Backend: update pino-http@11
Backend: update dotenv@18
Backend: apply minor and patch dependency updates
CI: stop the secret scan tripping on test fixtures (rename test constants)
Open-source readiness: fix contributor setup, SECURITY history note, CHANGELOG, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, CI badge; mobile API_URL configurable
Add new-team-member Getting Started guide; fix stale doc references
Tests: pin env so a local backend/.env cannot change results
Fix horizontal overflow on phones (tab rows, sr-only cells), make e2e robust; README note
Self-check recognises any AI provider key
Merge multi-provider AI (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini)
e2e smoke: final tweaks
Tests for OpenAI and Gemini providers against local wire-format mock servers
Document provider choice and new AI env vars

Provider-neutral AI layer: Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini behind one interface

The assistant loop, notes-to-tasks and the digest summary now call services/ai
instead of the Anthropic SDK. Stored messages keep the neutral text/tool_use/
tool_result block shape (no migration needed; vendor-only blocks are ignored).
Fix uploads from the browser (FormData sent with a JSON Content-Type), mobile overflow on Budget tabs, global-user upload target, runtime Google client id, e2e smoke test
Startup self-check + /api/admin/system-status + Settings > System; same-origin build; scheduler on by default in production; .env.example documents every var (test-enforced); remove obsolete scripts
Frontend: tolerate client-safe invoice detail, venture/company-wide target for global uploads
Merge branch into main

frontend: trailingSlash export so the backend serves /dashboard, no assistant launcher for clients

Found by walking every menu per role in a browser against the real backend:
express.static redirected /dashboard to /dashboard/ which had no index.html and
fell through to the login redirect. Clients also triggered a 403 on /api/assistant/status.
Tests: start demo-seeded suites from an empty users table (order-dependent flake)
frontend: split ClientPortalView, CalendarView, ChatView, DepartmentKPIsView into model/panel modules

frontend: split SettingsView, real notification preferences, same-origin API default, honest empty reports, .env.example

The old Settings quiet-hours/email toggles were saved into notification_preferences
and overwrote the server's digest/alerts/email keys; they are replaced by the real
GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences switches.
CI: least-privilege permissions (contents: read)
CSRF: Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site/content-type guard for cookie-authenticated writes; drop urlencoded parser
Authorise on the stored level (withScope + atLeast), remove JWT-claim requireLevel
Reduce info leaks: internal-only pickers, scoped recentActivity, minimal /api/ready

frontend: lint to zero, typed API layer, declarative menu with URL-synced views, split views, useApi/ErrorBoundary, invite/approval/rate UI

Ported from the stale wip-b3-frontend branch onto the current backend contracts.
Lint is now blocking in CI.
Documents: global uploads need an explicit ventureId or companyWide=true
Rates: only L1 may set rates for L1/L2 (incl. self)
Move /auth/me and /auth/logout out of the shared per-IP auth limiter
Invoices: clients get totals and client-safe line fields only
Scope user profile activity to tasks the viewer may see
Disconnect sockets on session revoke/logout/deactivation/venture or level change; pin HS256 for sockets
Fix OTP lockout DoS: count attempts only against a live OTP, reset on lock, per-email limiter keyed by email+IP
Update handoff: B2 merged, B3 pending
Merge assistant, search, digest/alerts and notes-to-tasks; renumber migrations 0007-0009
Merge branch into main
Document AI features and their environment variables
Add Notes to tasks review modal to the assistant view
Add handoff notes for resuming the hardening effort
Add meeting notes to draft tasks: scoped proposal endpoint and confirmed creation through the task path
Add weekly digest, daily alert rules, advisory-locked scheduler and notification preferences
Security pass: secret-field sweep test over every GET route, CSP upgrade only with Secure cookies, production config warnings, CI audit step

Production packaging and docs: Dockerfile, production compose, backups, checklist, README rewrite

- multi-stage Dockerfile (web export built into the API image, non-root, healthcheck)
- docker-compose.yml is the production stack (named volumes, required secrets, loopback
  publish, no db port); docker-compose.dev.yml is the loopback-only dev database
- deployment/backup (nightly pg_dump + restore), production-env.example, cloudflare example
- docs/production-checklist.md; README accurate to the current product
- delete obsolete MySQL-era scripts/reports, personal-domain deployment guides, build_package.js
Add Ask InternalX UI: full view, streaming chat, tool chips, floating launcher panel
Ops readiness: pino JSON logs with request ids and redaction, health/ready split, CORS/trust-proxy/cookie env, upload magic-byte sniffing
Add Ask InternalX assistant backend: scoped read-only tools, streaming agent loop, caps, audit
users test: list includes global leadership
Team-members list: venture staff never get clients or other ventures; global leadership stays DM-able

Invite-only by default: self-registration policy, pending approval, invite flow

- /api/auth/register is 403 unless ALLOW_SELF_REGISTRATION=true; when on, accounts are
  inactive + pending_approval with no venture (GET /api/team-members?pending=true,
  approval needs a venture)
- POST /api/team-members now invites (72h set-password link, emailed or returned once
  when SMTP is missing, never logged); POST /:id/invite re-issues for never-signed-in users
- GET /api/auth/config, minimal register / user-create / reset-password page edits
- escape HTML in email templates
Add Ctrl/Cmd-K command palette backed by /api/search

Migrations: one directory, robust runner, auto-migrate at boot, schema equivalence test

Consolidates backend/migrations and deployment/postgres/migrations into numbered
idempotent files (0001 baseline builds the whole schema), removes
create_missing_tables.js, adds advisory lock, per-file transaction, checksums,
AUTO_MIGRATE and /api/ready.
Add scoped full-text search (GET /api/search) with GIN indexes and tests
Merge data isolation (scope layer, chat authorization, real hourly rates, IDOR matrix tests)
seed-demo: also remove projects created by demo users
Document the access model, chat rules, money source and migrations
UI: handle missing/hidden rates; add dev-token script
CI: run migrations and the backend test suite
Money tests: rate source, missing-rate reporting, rate endpoint

Merge identity and admin hardening (bootstrap admin, user ceilings, Google invite-only, DB explorer and permission editors removed, Jest suite)

Resolves conflicts by taking the reworked user/auth/server code, keeps the patched
dependency set, and un-ignores src/config/env.js that the env.* secret rule hid.
Chat tests (REST + real sockets); resolve socket rooms before connect to avoid handler race

Add backend test suite and CI job; unique JWT ids

Jest + Supertest tests (TEST_DATABASE_URL, init SQL applied) cover bootstrap,
canManageUser, user-route ceilings and last-L1 protection, Google login rules
(google-auth-library mocked), OTP lockout, session revocation on password
reset/change, config validation and removed endpoints. New backend-tests CI
job. Tokens now carry a jti so concurrent logins are distinct sessions;
body-parse errors return a generic message.
Add demo seed and cross-venture IDOR test matrix; fix kpis GROUP BY and client chat access

Harden auth, remove DB explorer and unenforced permission editors

Auth: per-account OTP attempt counter with lockout (atomic, checked before
the code), generic OTP failure message, constant-time unknown-user login,
password reset revokes all sessions, per-mailbox rate limit, cookies
SameSite=Strict, HS256 pinned, generic 5xx bodies, no query values in logs,
JWT_SECRET/DB env validated at boot (production fails fast).

Removed: the raw-SQL Database explorer, the access_levels/venture_roles
permission-matrix editors (never enforced), the dead 2FA toggle and
config.json, in backend, web and mobile. The venture_roles tables and
access_levels.permissions column are dropped from the init schema, with
migration SQL for existing databases. User Management UI now offers only the
levels/ventures the actor may grant and generates a random temporary password
instead of a shared default.
team_rate: guard per route
Add PUT /api/team-members/:id/rate (hourly rate, L<=3)
Chat UI: server-provided channels, no join-by-index, REST-only send, typing payload
Chat: server-side authorisation, single persist+emit path, validated socket rooms

Scope analytics, budget, kpis, client portal, learning, strategy, audit and projects

Venture/project scoping from utils/scope.js, clients locked to client-safe
data, money from the single rate source, Postgres fixes (ANY($1::int[]),
integer division, GROUP BY, open transactions on early return).

Enforce one user-management policy via canManageUser()

New utils/canManageUser.js decides create/update/delete/level/venture/
deactivate: only L1-L3 manage users, strictly below their own level, L3 only
inside its own venture, no self-promotion/self-delete, last active L1 is
untouchable. All user mutations run in a locked transaction, take the actor's
level from the DB, revoke sessions on level/venture/active changes and audit
both successes and denials. Also tightens GET visibility for the team list,
ventures and access-levels. Adds Jest + Supertest setup and tests.

Scope tasks, timesheets, invoices and documents; price from the rate source

Fixes IDOR in updateTask/deleteTask, timesheet approval (venture check,
self-approval), venture taken from request body in logHours and document
upload, invoice details venture check. Invented rates removed.

Make Google login invite-only and verify the Google email

Require email_verified and the shared ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS list (also used by
register), refuse when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is unset, and never create accounts:
a user row must already exist. Removes the is_verified ReferenceError and the
integer-into-BOOLEAN insert.

Add data-scope helper, rate source helper, migration runner and schema columns

scope.js is the single source of truth for venture/project/task/timesheet/
document/chat visibility; rates.js is the one place money is computed.

Replace seeded admin passwords with first-run bootstrap

Init SQL no longer inserts users with a publicly known bcrypt hash. First
boot creates an L1 from BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD (12+ chars, no
placeholders); `npm run create-admin` covers later cases. Demo users moved
to seed:dev which refuses NODE_ENV=production. Legacy MySQL schema/seed files
carrying the shared hash are removed.
Merge branch into main
Update dependencies to patched versions

Remove one-off scripts and unused schema files

Deleted backend/scratch/, backend/src/config/schema.sql and create_db.sql,
and one-off root scripts (alter*.js, check_*.js, test_*.js, etc.). Nothing
in package.json, CI, Docker files or source referenced them.

Turn off demo mode

kDemoMode was hard-coded to true, so builds ran on canned data with
writes that silently do nothing.

Audit document deletion

deleteDocument removed the file and row without writing an audit entry.

Audit user deletion

DELETE /api/users/:id removed the user without writing an audit entry.

Remove unused ensureTables helper from role management routes

Nothing called it; it was dead code.

Hide internal error messages from API responses

Return a generic message for 5xx and for errors without an explicit
status. The full error is still logged server-side.

Stop logging query parameter values on DB errors

Parameters can contain passwords, tokens and personal data. SQL text and
the error message are still logged.

Fix project member lookup to use = ANY for array param

IN (?) with a JS array binds a single array parameter, which Postgres
rejects. = ANY(?) accepts the array.

Revoke all sessions on password reset

resetPassword updated the password hash but left existing sessions valid,
so anyone holding a stolen session kept access after the reset.

items.title: Generate an OpenAPI specification for the REST API
items.body:
## Summary
The API has no machine-readable description, which makes client generation, testing and onboarding harder.

## What to do
- Produce `openapi.yaml` (3.1) covering auth, users, projects, tasks, timesheets, documents, chat, search and notifications, including the access level required by each route and the security scheme (cookie session or bearer token).
- Prefer generating or validating it from the code/validators rather than maintaining a second copy by hand; at minimum add a CI check that the spec is valid.
- Serve it at `GET /api/docs` only for signed-in Super Admin / Managing Director users, or publish it as a static doc.

## Acceptance criteria
- Spec validates with a standard linter.
- Responses document the fields clients actually receive (and never password hashes or tokens).
